However, data are deficient for environmental, endocrine disruption, inhalation, and organ/systemic hazards (ENV4, EDC4, IHL4, OGN4), suggesting significant information gaps for these areas.
Q2: Currently, L-Ascorbic acid is not identified on any major lists of concern.
